## BM AML atlas

```{r}
aml_like_types <- c("LSC", "GMP-like", "HSC-like",
                    "Prog-like", "cDC-like")
```

# Prepare data

## Build fine-grained reference labels for the Bone Marrow single-cell reference

```{r}
cd_bm <- as.data.frame(colData(dat_aml_bm))

cd_bm$fine_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(cd_bm$HSPC.Cell.Type) & cd_bm$HSPC.Cell.Type %in% aml_like_types ~
    as.character(cd_bm$HSPC.Cell.Type),
  TRUE ~ as.character(cd_bm$cell_type)
)

colData(dat_aml_bm)$fine_label <- cd_bm$fine_label

table(dat_aml_bm$fine_label, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Subset Blood reference to 10X cells and build its fine-grained label

```{r}
dat_pb_10x <- dat_pb[, dat_pb$method == "10X"]
```

```{r}
pb_label_col <- "broad_cell_class"
colData(dat_pb_10x)$fine_label <- as.character(colData(dat_pb_10x)[[pb_label_col]])

table(dat_pb_10x$fine_label, useNA = "ifany")
```

## QC: donor-by-celltype coverage in Blood single-cell reference (10X subset)

```{r}
bm_samples <- dge_red$samples$specimenType == "Bone Marrow Aspirate"
pb_samples <- dge_red$samples$specimenType == "Peripheral Blood"

build_bulk_eset <- function(dge, keep) {
  counts <- dge$counts[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  pdata  <- data.frame(
    SubjectName = dge$samples$OriginalSampleName[keep],
    row.names   = colnames(counts)
  )
  Biobase::ExpressionSet(
    assayData   = as.matrix(counts),
    phenoData   = Biobase::AnnotatedDataFrame(pdata)
  )
}

bm_bulk_eset <- build_bulk_eset(dge_red, bm_samples)
pb_bulk_eset <- build_bulk_eset(dge_red, pb_samples)
```

## Build the combined PB reference (Blood 10X atlas + AML cells from BM atlas)

```{r}
aml_cells_idx <- which(dat_aml_bm$fine_label %in% aml_like_types)
aml_counts    <- assay(dat_aml_bm, "counts")[, aml_cells_idx, drop = FALSE]
aml_fine      <- dat_aml_bm$fine_label[aml_cells_idx]
aml_donor     <- paste0("BM_", dat_aml_bm$donor_id[aml_cells_idx])

pb_counts <- assay(dat_pb_10x, "decontXcounts")
pb_fine   <- dat_pb_10x$fine_label
pb_donor  <- paste0("PB_", dat_pb_10x$donor_id)

common_genes <- intersect(rownames(aml_counts), rownames(pb_counts))

aml_counts <- aml_counts[common_genes, ]
pb_counts  <- pb_counts[common_genes, ]

combined_counts <- cbind(aml_counts, pb_counts)
combined_fine   <- c(aml_fine, pb_fine)
combined_donor  <- c(aml_donor, pb_donor)

pb_sc_sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = combined_counts),
  colData = DataFrame(cellType = combined_fine, SubjectName = combined_donor)
)

table(colData(pb_sc_sce)$cellType)
```

# MuSiC

## Running and results tables

```{r,  results='asis'}
bm_select_ct <- setdiff(unique(dat_aml_bm$fine_label), NA)

music_bm_file <- file.path(params$rds_dir, "music_bm_estimation.rds")

if(!file.exists(music_bm_file)){

  music_bm <- music_prop(
    bulk.mtx  = exprs(bm_bulk_eset),
    sc.sce    = dat_aml_bm,
    clusters  = "fine_label",
    samples   = "donor_id",
    select.ct = bm_select_ct,
    verbose   = TRUE
  )
  saveRDS(music_bm, file = music_bm_file)

} else {

  music_bm <- readRDS(music_bm_file )

}

bm_prop <- as.data.frame(music_bm$Est.prop.weighted) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

print(htmltools::tagList(datatable(bm_prop,
                                   extensions = "Buttons", options = list(
                                     dom = "Bfrtip",
                                     buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
                                   )) %>%
                         formatRound(
                            columns = setdiff(colnames(bm_prop), c("sample_id")),
                            digits = 3
                          )
                         ))
```

## MuSiC results

### Fine resolution {.tabset}

```{r}
drop_zero_celltypes <- function(prop_df, tol = 1e-8) {
  col_sums   <- colSums(prop_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  zero_cols  <- names(col_sums)[col_sums <= tol]
  if (length(zero_cols) > 0) {
    cat("Dropping zero-proportion cell types: ", paste(zero_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  prop_df[, !(colnames(prop_df) %in% zero_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

bm_prop <- drop_zero_celltypes(bm_prop)
pb_prop <- drop_zero_celltypes(pb_prop)
```

```{r}
library(viridis)
```

### Post-hoc checks

```{r}
rollup_proportions <- function(prop_df, aml_types) {
  aml_cols   <- intersect(aml_types, colnames(prop_df))
  other_cols <- setdiff(colnames(prop_df), c("sample_id", "Erythroid", aml_cols))

  prop_df %>%
    mutate(
      prop_AML       = rowSums(across(all_of(aml_cols))),
      prop_Erythroid = if ("Erythroid" %in% colnames(prop_df)) Erythroid else 0,
      prop_Other     = rowSums(across(all_of(other_cols)))
    ) %>%
    select(sample_id, prop_AML, prop_Erythroid, prop_Other, everything())
}

bm_prop_rolled <- rollup_proportions(bm_prop, aml_like_types)
pb_prop_rolled <- rollup_proportions(pb_prop, aml_like_types)
```

```{r}
diag_bm <- tibble(
  sample_id    = names(music_bm$r.squared.full),
  r_squared_bm = music_bm$r.squared.full
)
diag_pb <- tibble(
  sample_id    = names(music_pb$r.squared.full),
  r_squared_pb = music_pb$r.squared.full
)

deconv_all <- bind_rows(
  bm_prop_rolled %>% left_join(diag_bm, by = "sample_id") %>% mutate(tissue = "BM", r_squared = r_squared_bm),
  pb_prop_rolled %>% left_join(diag_pb, by = "sample_id") %>% mutate(tissue = "PB", r_squared = r_squared_pb)
) %>%
  select(sample_id, tissue, prop_AML, prop_Erythroid, prop_Other, r_squared)

dge_red$samples <- dge_red$samples %>%
  left_join(deconv_all, by = c("OriginalSampleName" = "sample_id"))
```

# CIBERSORTx

## Procedure on the web portal

### Bulk mixture files (one per specimen type)

```{r}
gene_map_bm <- as.data.frame(rowData(dat_aml_bm)) %>%
  select(ensembl_id = 1, gene_symbol) %>%
  distinct()

gene_map_bm <- data.frame(
  ensembl_id  = rownames(dat_aml_bm),
  gene_symbol = rowData(dat_aml_bm)$gene_symbol,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% distinct()

gene_map_pb <- data.frame(
  ensembl_id  = rownames(dat_pb),
  gene_symbol = rowData(dat_pb)$feature_name,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% distinct()

gene_map <- bind_rows(gene_map_bm, gene_map_pb) %>%
  distinct(ensembl_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)

cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(dge_red$counts, log = FALSE)

symbol_map <- gene_map[match(rownames(cpm_mat), gene_map$ensembl_id), "gene_symbol"]
cpm_df <- as.data.frame(cpm_mat) %>%
  mutate(GeneSymbol = symbol_map) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol)) %>%
  group_by(GeneSymbol) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop") %>% as.data.frame()

bm_samples <- dge_red$samples$OriginalSampleName[dge_red$samples$specimenType == "Bone Marrow Aspirate" ]
pb_samples <- dge_red$samples$OriginalSampleName[dge_red$samples$specimenType == "Peripheral Blood"]

write.table(cpm_df[, c("GeneSymbol", bm_samples)],
            file.path(params$table_dir, "mixture_BM.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(cpm_df[, c("GeneSymbol", pb_samples)],
            file.path(params$table_dir, "mixture_PB.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Single-cell reference files (BM and PB)

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Matrix)

export_sc_reference <- function(sce, label_col, gene_map, out_path, max_cells_per_class = 100) {
  counts_mat <- assay(sce, "counts")
  labels <- colData(sce)[[label_col]]

  set.seed(1)
  keep_idx <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_along(labels), labels), function(idx) {
    sample(idx, size = min(length(idx), max_cells_per_class))
  }))
  counts_mat <- counts_mat[, keep_idx]
  labels <- as.character(labels[keep_idx])

  symbol_map <- gene_map$gene_symbol[match(rownames(counts_mat), gene_map$ensembl_id)]
  keep_genes <- !is.na(symbol_map)
  counts_mat <- counts_mat[keep_genes, ]
  symbol_map <- symbol_map[keep_genes]

  dense <- as.matrix(counts_mat)
  collapsed <- rowsum(dense, group = symbol_map)
  colnames(collapsed) <- labels

  out <- data.frame(GeneSymbol = rownames(collapsed), collapsed,
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  write.table(out, out_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
}

export_sc_reference(dat_aml_bm, "fine_label", gene_map,
                    file.path(params$table_dir, "reference_BM.txt"))
export_sc_reference(pb_sc_sce, "cellType", gene_map,
                    file.path(params$table_dir, "reference_PB.txt"))
```
